text:
evan: Saw invoice-preview wobble for two customers at 11:07 UTC. Looks like route tag flip during a sku rollout. Preview zeroed briefly then filled back in. Filing here.

priya: can you paste a trace/sample events? suspect route metadata volatility + heartbeat TTL race.

evan: tenant=orbit-labs, trace=`tr-5e7`. logs:
```
2025-06-03T11:06:55Z INFO route-resolver update tag=sku=alpha -> route:r2
2025-06-03T11:07:00Z WARN quota-heartbeat gap tenant=orbit-labs window=45s
2025-06-03T11:07:01Z INFO metering-event emitted tokens=142 route=r2 fingerprint=fp-322 session=sess-77
```

cody: our preview dedupe key is `tenant|fingerprint|route_tag`. If route_tag changes mid-session, preview aggregation can momentarily miscount due to ordering. Billing finalization downstream still matches actual usage.

priya: product wants per-SKU preview breakdown though. Can't remove route_tag from dedupe globally.

evan: suggestion: implement a preview-only "soft-map" at ingest. If same tenant+session+fingerprint sees a new route within a short window (TTL=75s), record an alias to canonical_preview_tag (the first observed tag). Preview dedupe resolves via canonical_preview_tag; billing path stays strict.

metrics-bot: alert: heartbeat-jitter spike at 11:05-11:08 (dash link). ingest-bot: NOTICE partition-3 lag 11:04-11:09 consumer-lag=13s

pm-ryan: thumbs-up for preview-only approach. Request console hint: "Preview may temporarily group route tag variants for short windows; invoices unaffected."

cody: implementation notes: add in-memory alias map keyed by tenant|session|fingerprint -> canonical_preview_tag, TTL 75s, emitted log `preview_alias_emitted {tenant,fingerprint,session,observed,canonical}`. Expose metric `preview_alias_count` per-tenant.

priya: QA: unit tests for alias map, integration tests across ingest->preview with rA->rB flips, check no cross-tenant leakage. Also test that billing path remains unchanged.

evan: rollout plan: behind feature-flag `preview_soft_map`. Canary 2% tenants for 3h; monitor `invoice_preview_diff_pct`, `preview_alias_count`, and support tickets. If safe, increase to 20% then full.

pm-ryan: add copy for console tooltip and a short note in the preview panel during canary. Product will inform EAP customers.

cody: i'll open the PR and add telemetry. pinging @eng-platform when canary ready.

evan: thanks all. follow-up: audit other dedupe keys that include mutable metadata (region, placement). adding a backlog ticket.
